mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usuario (username, password, persona_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{personaId})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.token_refresh, u.intentos_fallidos, u.bloqueado, u.activo, u.ultimo_acceso, u.persona_id, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted, u.version FROM usuario u WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = FALSE

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.token_refresh, u.intentos_fallidos, u.bloqueado, u.activo, u.ultimo_acceso, u.persona_id, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted, u.version, p.id AS persona_id, p.nombre AS p_nombre, p.primer_apellido AS p_primer_apellido, p.segundo_apellido AS p_segundo_apellido, p.ci AS p_ci, p.telefono AS p_telefono, p.email AS p_email, p.fecha_nacimiento AS p_fecha_nacimiento, p.genero AS p_genero, p.direccion_id AS p_direccion_id FROM usuario u LEFT JOIN persona p ON p.id = u.persona_id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = FALSE
SELECT r.nombre FROM rol r INNER JOIN usuario_rol ur ON ur.rol_id = r.id AND r.deleted = FALSE WHERE ur.usuario_id = #{usuarioId} AND ur.deleted = FALSE
SELECT DISTINCT pe.nombre FROM permiso pe INNER JOIN usuario_rol ur ON ur.rol_id = pe.rol_id AND ur.deleted = FALSE WHERE ur.usuario_id = #{usuarioId} AND pe.deleted = FALSE

mapper.update: UPDATE usuario SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, persona_id = #{personaId}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE usuario SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE usuario SET token_refresh = #{tokenRefresh}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE usuario SET ultimo_acceso = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE usuario SET intentos_fallidos = intentos_fallidos + 1, bloqueado = CASE WHEN intentos_fallidos + 1 >= 5 THEN TRUE ELSE bloqueado END, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.token_refresh, u.intentos_fallidos, u.bloqueado, u.activo, u.ultimo_acceso, u.persona_id, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted, u.version, p.id AS persona_id, p.nombre AS p_nombre, p.primer_apellido AS p_primer_apellido, p.segundo_apellido AS p_segundo_apellido, p.ci AS p_ci, p.telefono AS p_telefono, p.email AS p_email, p.fecha_nacimiento AS p_fecha_nacimiento, p.genero AS p_genero, p.direccion_id AS p_direccion_id FROM usuario u LEFT JOIN persona p ON p.id = u.persona_id AND p.deleted = FALSE WHERE u.persona_id = #{personaId} AND u.deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
